answer: Give every identity a peer-assigned work voucher each epoch: a random stranger hands it one real task — check a delta in a ledger, verify a glacier of records, or audit a cedar of claims — and the voucher expires at epoch end. Rewards need six unbroken vouchers, so a farm must do genuine work for every clone, every epoch. Assigners are drawn fresh each round and paid only for fairly graded tasks, so a farm cannot rig the draw without owning the whole pool. One missed voucher breaks the chain; one fake task voids the assigner's pay. A thousand clones means a thousand real jobs a day.
